name: whisper-large-v3-turbo-swiss-german
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A finetune of openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.809 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence cc-by-nc-4.0, repo created 2025-05-22. CAVEATS: CC-BY-NC-4.0 (inherited from whisper-large-v3-turbo) - not usable commercially. The comparison is on a 16,384-item random sample of the TRAINING split, not a held-out test set, so the 6.5-point WER gap is optimistic. Twice the parameters of what the family name suggests (0.809B). Also note checkpoint-750 was selected on validation WER 37.96 and later checkpoints degraded.
